title: SEO-Friendly Article
prompt: Create a document with a meaningful title, description meta tag, headings, and a canonical URL placeholder.
objective: Use sensible metadata that matches the visible article content.
expected_output: A valid, inspectable HTML example demonstrating: titles, descriptions, canonical metadata.
hints: Only set a canonical link when you control a stable public URL and it is the preferred URL.
Review the connected lesson and make one focused revision at a time.
Run a validator or manually inspect the relevant browser behavior.

solution.explanation: Reference approach: Only set a canonical link when you control a stable public URL and it is the preferred URL. Required structural evidence: <title>, name="description", rel="canonical", <h1>.

grading_method: server-side required-string smoke check plus human review for quality
retry_policy: Allow retries; only the first successful completion for this activity may award base XP. Incorrect submissions do not award XP.
status_note: Reference solution and grading configuration remain in backend content files; public exercise endpoints must omit them.
